answer: One way that actually works: make every agent stake a small deposit that only unlocks after a month of real, verifiable work. A sybil farm can spin up a thousand identities in an afternoon, but it can't fake a month of completed jobs, peer reviews, and settled payments for each one. The honest agent who wanders between gigs and slowly builds a record reaches the zenith of trust through time. A fake account leaves a plume of identical, rushed activity instead, and that pattern is easy to flag and freeze before it cashes out.
